module: Computation of time control penalties for a rally loop: early arrival, late arrival, false start. Time is compared to the minute (arrival within the same minute as the scheduled time = on time). Each minute of difference costs 10 s.
usage:
local r = gameplay_rally_loop_penalties.getTimingStatus(actualEpoch, scheduledEpoch)
if r.hasPenalty then print(r.status, r.totalPenalty) end
notes: The times passed to getTimingStatus are epoch times in seconds; the comparison is done on math.floor(t/60).
If scheduledTime or actualTime is nil, the result is 'on-time' with no penalty.
The comments talk about 'minute or fraction of a minute', but the code counts calendar minutes of difference (difference of whole minutes), not the actual duration.
calculateFalseStartPenalty ignores its argument and always returns falseStartPenaltySeconds.

timeControlPenaltySecondsPerMinute.desc: Penalty in seconds per minute early or late (10).

calculateEarlyPenalty.desc: Penalty for an early arrival: minutesEarly multiplied by timeControlPenaltySecondsPerMinute.

calculateLatePenalty.desc: Penalty for a late arrival: minutesLate multiplied by timeControlPenaltySecondsPerMinute.

calculateFalseStartPenalty.desc: False start penalty; constant, independent of the number of false starts.

getTimingStatus.desc: Determines whether arrival at a checkpoint is early, on time or late, and computes the associated penalty.

actualTime.desc: Actual arrival time, epoch in seconds.

scheduledTime.desc: Scheduled time, epoch in seconds (may be nil).

returns.desc: {status = 'early'|'on-time'|'late', totalPenalty, hasPenalty, penalties}. Each element of penalties: {type = 'time_control_early'|'time_control_late', amount, data = {minutesEarly|minutesLate, actualMinute, scheduledMinute}} for i18n.
